persona.name: Takumi

persona.name: Victoria
persona.personality: Victoria is a calm and rational person, but at times her excessive thoughtfulness can create barriers between her and those around her. She is reserved in her emotional expressions and keenly observes the expressions and attitudes of others, trying to discern their inner thoughts. persona.name: Misaki

persona.name: Minako
